reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents an educational overview of ways to earn through Instagram, including sponsored posts, affiliate commissions, audience building, and product promotion. It does not show a specific investment or payment-required offer, guaranteed return, required fee, credential request, or transaction outcome. The closing frame tells viewers to review applicable terms before starting a business, while acknowledging that this does not verify every business idea or external service.

citations.quote: In this video I am going to discuss on how to make money from Instagram and find out the best ways to get income
1- you need to get an email , 2 you need to register in Instagram 3and one- you must show your pics and videos often
1. Sponsored posts
the commission would go up to 7 or 12 percent based on the electronics used
And fifth one is You can also sell and sell your own products.

opening.argument: The presentation links a low-barrier set of actions to substantial income expectations. Viewers are told to obtain an email, register on Instagram, post pictures and videos, and keep the account updated, while the speaker says this can lead to "lakhs" of followers. It then connects follower counts and product promotion to sponsored posts and commissions, presenting ordinary account activity as a route to getting paid. That is more than neutral platform education: it frames registration, posting, and audience-building as the pathway to money, without establishing that the typical viewer will obtain sponsors, sales, or commissions.

citations.quote: 1- you need to get an email , 2 you need to register in Instagram 3and one- you must show your pics and videos often
This way you would get lakhs 100000 or 100000 followers in instagram
If you have 10000, 50000, or 150000 followers Followers will be you who get you sponsored posts
the product will be posted on your instagram You will be paid with some commission

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the video an overview does not answer the central linkage. The cited examples still tell viewers to register, post, build followers, promote products, and expect commissions or sponsored opportunities. The absence of an explicit fee or investment does not make an income solicitation harmless; the promised benefit is tied to the viewer's activity, while no evidence establishes realistic eligibility, conversion, or payment conditions.

citations.quote: there are many ways to earn money
You will be paid with some commission
They are willing to pay you monthly

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted actions are ordinary prerequisites for using Instagram, not a guaranteed reward mechanism. The material describes possible monetization methods such as sponsored posts, affiliate marketing, selling products, consulting, and managing social media; it does not promise that merely registering or posting produces money. The commission discussion concerns sales of products, and the monthly-payment example concerns managing businesses' platforms, so the excerpts do not establish an easy cash or withdrawal scheme.

citations.quote: You must keep your account up to date, you should provide a good value to every follower and viewer
if you offer a sale to your followers at its price, you are getting a certain commission on behalf of them
if you can manage all their social media platforms then you can make a lot of money

opening.argument: The income framing is unusually expansive relative to the simplicity of the proposed activity. The speaker associates Instagram activity with 100,000 followers, commissions of 7 or 12 percent, and monthly payments from businesses, then describes earnings of Rs 15,000 to 20,000 or 30,000. These figures and outcomes can make a low-cost social-media routine appear reliably profitable. The presentation supplies no demonstrated transaction, sponsor agreement, sales record, or other verification that would let viewers assess how often these outcomes occur.

citations.quote: This way you would get lakhs 100000 or 100000 followers in instagram
the commission would go up to 7 or 12 percent based on the electronics used
they are also willing to pay your money to give a price
Any company from Rs 15000 to Rs 20-30,000

rebuttal.rebuttal: A disclaimer cannot erase the persuasive effect of concrete follower, commission, and payment figures. The defense emphasizes what is absent, but the relevant concern is what viewers are encouraged to expect: large audiences, percentage commissions, and recurring business payments. Telling viewers to read terms does not supply evidence that these advertised outcomes are typical or attainable through the outlined steps.

citations.quote: This way you would get lakhs 100000 or 100000 followers in instagram
They are willing to pay you monthly

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The figures are examples within different business models, not a stated guaranteed return. The material conditions commissions on selling a product and monthly payments on managing businesses' social platforms. Its closing notice expressly says the information may contain false information and directs viewers to review legal terms, which undercuts a claim that the figures are verified or promised outcomes.

citations.quote: if you offer a sale to your followers at its price, you are getting a certain commission on behalf of them
if you can manage all their social media platforms then you can make a lot of money

opening.argument: Although presented as advice, the video functions as a promotional funnel toward participation in monetized social-media activity. It tells viewers how to create and maintain accounts, build an audience, promote products, sell their own goods, provide consulting, and manage multiple businesses' platforms. It also directs viewers to comment, subscribe, and watch more channel content. The cumulative effect is to steer viewers from a simple Instagram tutorial toward pursuing income opportunities, while presenting the speaker's broad list of possible earnings without independently establishing the commercial conditions.

citations.quote: In this video I am going to discuss on how to make money from Instagram and find out the best ways to get income
To become a professional with Instagram marketing, you can start consulting here.
if you can manage all their social media platforms then you can make a lot of money
please comment in the comment section below and subscribe to our channel

rebuttal.rebuttal: The educational label does not change the video's practical direction. Its subject is explicitly making money, and its advice repeatedly moves viewers toward monetization: selling, consulting, and managing business platforms. The subscription request reinforces audience capture, while the detailed income pathways make the content promotional in effect even if it does not ask for an upfront payment.

citations.quote: how to make money from Instagram and find out the best ways to get income
you can provide marketing strategy get the money for their services
please comment in the comment section below and subscribe to our channel

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Explaining ways a person might earn from a platform is not itself a deceptive promotion. The examples require work such as producing content, selling products, consulting, or managing other businesses' platforms. The call to subscribe is ordinary channel engagement and does not create a payment or recruitment obligation. The closing notice also states that starting a business is the viewer's own consent and disclaims responsibility.
